# Review: plan:nav-dev-beside-prod — environment prerequisite correction

Head:4fa6ed9da056d5d3fbbb9f189205ba03301645af. Parent:dd9713a6e4adaad5b5ae748ab19adeaa8d1087dc. Reviewer:pij-unaware-quokka.

## Verdict: BLOCK — delivery/artifact evidence, not an introduced code defect

**The missing-env source finding at0cc is closed.** All original promotion/ownership/discovery/ESM findings are also closed by the preceding correction. Exact4fa delta is19insertions in justfile/docs only. Actual missing-file safety fixtures pass. The current fresh-worktree proof artifact emits real IconThemeProvider console errors; its FFT also began above the then-in-force load policy. Neither is mislabeled as a new4fa source bug, and neither is silently hidden by declaring the full delivery green.

## Corrective source accepted

`justfile:43–49` checks required apps/web/.env.local and returns a clear fix message. Call sites:

| Recipe | Exact order |
|---|---|
| dev | env29 → claim30 → cache31 → node-pty32 → launch35 |
| dev-https | env129 → claim130 → cache131 → node-pty132 → launch135 |
| prod | env162 → check-only claim163 → build164 |
| prod-serve | build guard189 → node-pty194 → env196 → claim197 → promote198 → launch204 |

Env is not literally first in prod-serve; build/node-pty precede it, but every checked prerequisite precedes destructive port claim/promotion. This meets the reported missing-file correction. No claim that all possible runtime failures are statically preflighted. `.complete` safety, retained `.old` rollback and prod-sidecar ownership protection remain intact from0cc.

## Independent failure-path proof

Delegated implementation-capable agent pinned exact4fa justfile byte-for-byte into a disposable fixture (SHA25671bbd6742f1baebe09c2da70366bda1b7eb33c76492a3f8d49fead24cefcabe0). Owned dummyHTTP listener60507; real node-pty dependency symlinked into fixture, actual spawn probe returned0. A pnpm safety sentinel would record any build/app invocation and exit99; it was never invoked.

Actually ran helper,dev,dev-https,prod,prod-serve with missing.env.local and KILL_EXISTING=1. All returned1 with the actionable missing-file message. After each: same listener alive/HTTP200; current BUILD_ID, staged BUILD_ID and .complete unchanged in inode/nanosecond-mtime/size/hash. No build/app server launched. Empty.env.local then made the helper return0; success recipes were not launched in that fixture. Listener terminated/reaped and fixture removed. No author/runtime env or build tree modified.

## Delivery issue A — Actual retained artifact logs icon errors

Localhost and LAN browser console each emit `[IconThemeProvider] [object Object]`. Source `apps/web/src/features/_platform/themes/components/icon-theme-provider.tsx:37–50` fetches public/icons/<theme>/manifest.json and logs failure. The generated material-icon manifest is absent from this fresh -env worktree. This is the runtime consequence of the same missing artifact that skips4icon tests below, not merely a theoretical coverage note.

Web is a Turbo cache hit. Build outputs restore dist/.next but omit generated public/icons; the replayed “Icons up to date — skipping” line does NOT prove generation ran in this worktree. Prime identifies this as backlogB6 (generate in setup or fail, not skip). No19-line4fa source change caused the icon omission. Nevertheless, AGENTS requires observed runtime console errors to be fixed or explicitly resolved, not waived as unrelated; the actual current surface is not console-error-free. No suppression/re-pinning was performed.

**Lift:** B6 owner supplies a correctly provisioned artifact and verifies the affected page with no IconThemeProvider errors; retain actual browser evidence. Generating the real missing artifact is required, not hiding the error or skipping checks. Reviewer did not repair product/setup code under the read-only role.

Preserved wrapper records15:42:35/1-minload62.60, exactHEAD4fa,rc0/507s,end15:51:02/load17.15. Author acknowledges62.60 exceeds the wave's then-required<60. Ending load does not retroactively meet launch policy.

Prime later retired his load<60policy (governance0dd566dff, about16:05); this was NOT an AGENTS/Jordan gate and is not represented as one. Record the historical breach. Prime explicitly accepts remediation through the next composed green FFT, rather than inventing a code defect or requiring an extra reviewer build. A later composed run must be actually reviewed/provenanced; running work is not already evidence.
